# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 03, Serye ng Taong 2021

**Isang Kautusang Bayan na Nag-Aadopt at Pinagtitibay ang DILG MC No. 2020-036 na may Petsang Pebrero 17, 2020 na may Titulo na "Prohibiting Tricycles, Pedicabs, and Motorized Pedicabs from Operating on National Highways"**

_(Adopting DILG MC No. 2020-036 Prohibiting Tricycles, Pedicabs, and Motorized Pedicabs from Operating on National Highways)_

## Summary

Enacted on March 22, 2021, this ordinance adopts DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2020-036 dated February 17, 2020, titled "Pag-aalis ng lahat na nakakasagabal sa pampublikong daan," which prohibits tricycles, pedicabs, and motorized pedicabs from operating on national highways within the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. The ordinance also references DILG MC dated January 21, 2021, "Guidelines for Conduct of Validation of LGU Compliance with Road Clearing."

## Key Provisions

1. **Adoption of DILG MC No. 2020-036**: Formally adopts and implements the national directive prohibiting tricycles, pedicabs, and motorized pedicabs from operating on national highways.

2. **Prohibition on National Highways**: Tricycles, pedicabs, and motorized pedicabs are barred from plying national highways within municipal jurisdiction.

3. **Compliance with Road Clearing**: References the DILG MC of January 21, 2021, on validation of LGU compliance with road clearing operations.

4. **Enforcement**: Provides mechanisms for implementation and enforcement of the prohibition.
